morbi.headline: Mixed week for Morbi: Tile export projections drop while propane availability lowers input costs
what_changed: Somany Ceramics projected total tile exports to decline to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore.
Morbi ceramic units reduced PNG consumption following an improved supply of propane.
Apollo Pipes set a revenue target of Rs 1,000 crore for its ceramics business.
stress_signals: Overall tile exports projected to fall to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore [202e1481c238]
improvement_signals: Reduction in PNG consumption across ceramic units due to better propane supply availability [81469af468f3]
what_to_watch: Propane vs. PNG cost differentials and actual fuel substitution volumes in Morbi cluster.
Export order book trends and destination-specific demand slowdowns for tile exporters.
Apollo Pipes' market entry strategy and potential manufacturing partnerships or capacity setups.

surat.headline: Diamond demand rebounds while textiles face retail slowdown, higher processing costs, and tighter credit.
what_changed: Textile printing units raised charges by 15% and imposed a mandatory 45-day payment window post-Diwali.
Diamond manufacturers cut Diwali breaks in half and gem and jewellery exports rose 34.01% ahead of Christmas.
Crude oil prices dropped 17% in 10 days, offering feedstock cost relief to MMF textile units.
Textile Ministry initiated an industry-wide capacity database drive to track fabric production meter-by-meter.
stress_signals: Inflation-driven slowdown curb retail buying, causing distress among Surat textile traders [0fed4a76da43].
Surat Position Printing Association enforced a 15% rate hike and strict 45-day bill payment terms, pressuring weaver and trader working capital [ad48975ddfcf].
Textile waste godown fire incident in Surat required nine tenders, underscoring storage safety risks [317f5c9fd10d].
improvement_signals: Gem and jewellery exports jumped 34.01% driven by Christmas demand for polished diamonds and studded gold jewellery [c3b68570a07d].
Diamond processing units halved Diwali vacation days due to strong incoming order books [5fc0b7b85616].
A 17% drop in crude oil prices over 10 days provides operational cost relief to local synthetic textile processors [71350aa24679].
what_to_watch: Compliance with the 45-day payment window and working capital strain on fabric traders from the 15% printing rate hike.
Re-order rates and receivable cycles in gem and jewellery accounts post-Christmas export shipments.
Operational reporting impacts and documentation readiness for the Textile Ministry's fabric capacity database drive.
